$comment: Machine-readable index of the strategy knowledge base. strategies/validate.mjs reconciles this against the filesystem in both directions: a card on disk that is not listed here fails verify, and so does an entry here with no card. SCHEMA.md is the format spec; this file is the index the linter checks. Hand-editable, but `node strategies/validate.mjs` is the arbiter.
champion_note: No card has ever passed the gate. The linter enforces this: it fails if any card has status `promoted` while this is null, and fails if this is non-null while no card is promoted. Both directions are checked so the headline cannot drift from the cards.

noise_floor.note: The two negative controls define what a strategy with no information scores on this harness. It is NOT 1.0, because costs are charged on both sides of a churn-heavy trade stream. Read every profit factor against this band.

next_note: P-002 closed the unit hypothesis: the k ladder is flat (PF 0.899-0.935 bidirectional, 0.917-0.960 long-only against donchian's 0.917), so normalizing a threshold by ATR changes nothing. Every backlog idea assuming difficulty scales with volatility can be set aside. P-003 is the last queued card.

exit_model.note: Owned by the simulator. A strategy cannot express any of this, which is why exit-placement hypotheses are `blocked` rather than untested.
exit_model.source: research/run.mjs (--hold default 96) and research/protocol.v1.json (risk.max_hold_bars 96). research/harness.mjs DEFAULTS.maxHoldBars is 40, but that value is only reached when a caller omits maxHoldBars; `npm run research:all` does not pass --hold, so the recorded runs used 96.

exit_placement: P-005 note: fixed 2xATR stop + 96-bar time out guarantees you never hold the tail of a trend
v2_blocked_by.rule: A v2 is justified only when a hypothesis that already has a written, believed mechanism genuinely cannot be expressed. It runs as a separate generation with its own results archive, and is never mixed with v1.
